summary.name: StaticGen
summary.one_liner: A community-maintained showcase listing open source static site generators, ranked by GitHub stars, with language, template and license details for each.
use_cases: Comparing static site generators before choosing one
Finding a static site generator in a specific language
Checking license and template engine of an SSG
Discovering popular open source Jamstack frameworks
summary.what_it_does: The page is a community-driven gallery of open source static site generators, including Next.js, Hugo, Docusaurus, Nuxt, Gatsby, Astro, Hexo, MkDocs and Eleventy, among many smaller projects. Each entry shows a short description, GitHub star, fork and issue counts, primary language, supported template engines and license. Entries are listed in roughly descending order of star count. The page also links to a Deploy to Netlify option for many entries and invites users to submit new generators via pull request.
notable: Lists over 90 open source static site generators with GitHub stats, language, template engines and license
Community-driven; new generators are added via pull request
Many entries offer a one-click Deploy to Netlify option
caveats: Star and issue counts are a snapshot and may be out of date
Listed projects are not endorsed or verified by the page; licenses and features come from each project's own repository
